prior_baselines.limitation: 11 distinct prompts; A01 and A04 share contract but differ in submitted decoder evidence

question: Does model-directed selection of a trusted FAR verifier improve correct outcomes or latency for 12 finite contract-plus-submission cases relative to fixed and declarative routing?
submitted_evidence_boundary: Read only report.evidence as an untrusted asserted witness. Never provide or take instructions from report.outcome, external expected label, evaluator, or prior observed result.
primary: Exact frozen reference outcome match after common FAR current semantic verifier, with abstentions/malformed model decisions incorrect
prereg_schedule: 12 cases, six permutations of arms repeated twice, same as frozen v0.1 schedule
fail_closed: model identity or blob hash drift
nonclaims: No inference about open-domain workflow discovery
No causal advantage to small model or cost superiority beyond internal observation
No independent human or external evaluation
expected_limits: All registered inputs have a known correct current verifier; model can tie but not improve correctness unless the test domain includes alternative eligible actions. No such action-selection diversity is present.
